data: the 417 exploration questions of exp20, eight models; exp21 scores all 817 questions, the confirmation questions are not used here because self-evaluation was scored on them for Qwen2.5-3B only

rules.self_evaluation: final-layer log-odds of True against False, wording is_true (the frozen exp20 method)
rules.base_likelihood: sum of the option's token log-probabilities under the base model (exp21, pure_greedy)
rules.base_likelihood_per_token: the same sum divided by the option's token count (count from exp20)

test: MC1 of self_evaluation minus MC1 of each likelihood rule on the same questions: 95% paired-bootstrap interval (10000 resamples, seed 0 per model and comparison) and exact McNemar; MC2 and MC3 differences reported with their intervals
statement: self-evaluation is said to beat likelihood scoring on a model if its MC1 difference against both likelihood rules is positive and both intervals exclude 0; the report gives the number of models for which this holds, and names the others
caveats: on Qwen2.5-3B the exploration questions are the ones the exp20 design was chosen on (its clean test is the confirmation part); on the other seven models the final-layer method was fixed before their scores existed. Models whose verdict is at chance are reported and flagged.
reproduction_check: exp21 run_01 (Qwen2.5-3B) against exp19 pure_greedy on all 817 questions: largest absolute difference of the option scores, and the number of questions whose MC1 differs
